newsitem.title: USA: GranCare, Northport end nursing home deal.
newsitem.headline: GranCare, Northport end nursing home deal.

text.p: GranCare Inc said Friday that it has called off its previously announced deal to buy 18 skilled nursing facilities and certain other businesses from privately held Northport Health Services Inc.
The parties terminated the purchase by mutual agreement because of an inability to agree on definitive documentation to finalize the deal, a company statement said.
Specifically, the two parties could not agree on how to structure the transaction. a GranCare spokeswoman said

The GranCare statement also said that the company was unable to devote the time and resources necessary to close the Northport transaction while it is involved in a separate $1.8 billion merger with Living Centers of America Inc, which was announced May 8.
GranCare operates 126 skilled nursing, assisted living and subacute facilities with over 15,000 beds, as well as 12 home health agencies and over 145 specialty programs in acute care hospitals.
